method: Process CPU time, all threads, user+system; 100% means one CPU core. Startup, fixtures, compilation and validation excluded. Both paths include hex decode and public-key hex output. GPU CPU time includes Python packing, dispatch, wait and output conversion. Matched-load wall window includes scheduled sleep. EVM child CPU time reported separately. No power or GPU-utilization measurement.
evm_workload: Repeated independent execution of the same 512 valid transfers from the same genesis; output hash checked each iteration. No signing, signature verification, persistence, networking or consensus timed.
